scientific_scope.hypothesis: the qualified post-transient clean support is effectively a one-phase attractor

execution.extension_if_period_known_and_more_time_: when fewer than eight post-burn-in cycles remain or stationarity is improving but not settled, append max(1000, ceil(4 * period_steps)) steps, rounded up to the next 500 index

input_contract.required_output_indices: every integer from 499 through the final output index
input_contract.history: one finite final-inner-iteration row per output index with unique Time_Iter, Inner_Iter, CD, CL, CFx, and CFy
input_contract.phase_clock: CL only; it is not treated as a canonical force-accuracy target

state_weight_views.near_body_wake_uniform_node: required diagnostic on x in [-1,10], y in [-5,5]
state_weight_views.physical_vertex_area: required reported physical-integral view; not sufficient alone because the farfield dominates

period_estimation.signal: CL on the trailing 75 percent of available indices
period_estimation.acf_candidate: first post-zero-crossing local maximum with autocorrelation at least 0.8
period_estimation.spectral_candidate: largest non-DC spectral peak over the same admissible period range
period_estimation.crossing_smoothing_width: largest odd integer no smaller than 3 and nearest to period_acf / 50
period_estimation.cycle_boundaries: upward crossings of the smoothed CL median separated by 0.5 to 1.5 times period_acf, linearly interpolated
period_estimation.state_recurrence_alias_scan: scan uniform-node component-balanced five-field recurrence over integer lags from 0.8 to 1.2 times the period estimate using every available trailing state pair
period_estimation.state_recurrence_alias_normalization: normalize each field by its uniform-node RMS temporal variation over the trailing states, then take the RMS over the five normalized field errors; an exactly zero-variation field has exactly zero pairwise error and contributes zero

burn_in_and_stationarity.cycle_resampling: linear temporal interpolation between clean native outputs
scalar_signals: uniform-node spatial mean of each dynamic field
uniform-node spatial RMS about that mean for each dynamic field
burn_in_and_stationarity.template_comparison: compare first-half and second-half mean cycle templates for every scalar signal
burn_in_and_stationarity.template_normalizer: max(within-cycle RMS, 1e-8 times the full-signal RMS magnitude)
burn_in_and_stationarity.theil_sen_application: compute exact Theil-Sen total drift separately for each signal's per-cycle mean and per-cycle RMS amplitude; normalize both by the template normalizer and gate their maximum
burn_in_and_stationarity.burn_in_selection: earliest cycle boundary satisfying every stationarity gate
burn_in_and_stationarity.improving_transient_definition: across the final three eligible burn-in candidates, the maxima of normalized template shift, normalized Theil-Sen drift, and period MAD are each non-increasing, with at least one strict improvement

five_field_recurrence.physical_vertex_area_role: reported secondary view; it cannot qualify phase recurrence by itself
five_field_recurrence.normalization: per-field orbit amplitude; use field state RMS only when orbit-amplitude/state-RMS is below 1e-6
five_field_recurrence.comparison: adjacent complete post-burn-in cycles at 64 common phases
five_field_recurrence.component_balanced_cycle_error: square root of the mean squared normalized error over five fields

outcomes.PHASE_ONLY_SUPPORTED: all artifact, period, stationarity, cycle-count, and recurrence gates pass
outcomes.INSUFFICIENT_CYCLES: the observed prefix is too short to decide: either a coherent candidate leaves fewer than eight complete post-burn-in cycles, or the period remains unresolved or search-boundary-limited below the resource cap; the extension reason distinguishes these cases
outcomes.TRANSIENT_NOT_SETTLED: a coherent period exists and late stationarity metrics satisfy the frozen improving-transient definition but no burn-in passes; extend with the known-period rule
outcomes.MODULATED_LOW_DIMENSIONAL: a coherent period exists but stationary phase-only recurrence or template gates fail
outcomes.NO_COHERENT_PERIOD: period gates fail away from an extendable search boundary or remain unresolved at the resource cap
outcomes.INVALID_ARTIFACT: identity, schema, index, history, coordinate, cadence, or finiteness validation fails

promotion_rule.role_windows: content-disjoint solver-time blocks; common-attractor dependence is retained and disclosed
promotion_rule.statistics: deterministic finite-phase summaries; no IID confidence interval over phase anchors
promotion_rule.rollout_horizon: freeze as an integer number of measured shedding periods before any PCNO outcome
